best_time_to_buy_and_sell_stock.optimal:
min_price = +infinity, best = 0
for each price:
    profit = price - min_price   (sell today, bought on the cheapest day so far)
    if profit > best: best = profit
    if price < min_price: min_price = price
return best

minimum_size_subarray_sum.optimal:
left = 0, total = 0, best = 0
for each right:
    total += nums[right]
    while total >= target:   (valid window: record it, then try shorter)
        length = right - left + 1
        if best == 0 or length < best: best = length
        total -= nums[left]
        left += 1
return best

longest_substring_without_repeating_char.brute:
best = 0
for each start:
    seen = empty set   (rebuilt from scratch for every start)
    for each end from start to the last index:
        if s[end] is in seen: stop extending
        add s[end] to seen
    if size of seen > best: best = size of seen
return best
longest_substring_without_repeating_char.optimal:
last = empty dict (char -> index where it was most recently seen), left = 0, best = 0
for each right:
    ch = s[right]
    if ch is in last and last[ch] >= left:
        left = last[ch] + 1   (jump just past the earlier copy, never backwards)
    last[ch] = right
    length = right - left + 1
    if length > best: best = length
return best

max_consecutive_ones_iii.brute:
best = 0
for each start:
    zeros = 0   (recounted from scratch for every start)
    for each end from start to the last index:
        if nums[end] == 0: zeros += 1
        if zeros > k: stop extending
        length = end - start + 1
        if length > best: best = length
return best
max_consecutive_ones_iii.optimal:
left = 0, zeros = 0, best = 0
for each right:
    if nums[right] == 0: zeros += 1
    while zeros > k:   (k+1 zeros inside: push left past one zero)
        if nums[left] == 0: zeros -= 1
        left += 1
    length = right - left + 1
    if length > best: best = length
return best

longest_repeating_character_replacement.optimal:
count = 26 zeros, left = 0, max_freq = 0, best = 0
for each right:
    idx = letter index of s[right]
    count[idx] += 1
    if count[idx] > max_freq: max_freq = count[idx]   (never lowered: a smaller window can't win)
    if (right - left + 1) - max_freq > k:
        count[s[left]] -= 1
        left += 1
    length = right - left + 1
    if length > best: best = length
return best

min_stack.brute:
init: stack = empty list
push(val):
    append val to the list
pop():
    remove the last element
top():
    return the last element
get_min():
    return the minimum of the whole list   (O(n) rescan on every call)
min_stack.optimal:
init: stack = empty list of entries [value, min of everything at or below it]
push(val):
    current_min = val
    if the stack is not empty and the min stored on top < val:
        current_min = the min stored on top   (the entries below val never change under it)
    push [val, current_min]
pop():
    pop the top   (the entry below still holds its correct min)
top():
    return the value of the top entry
get_min():
    return the min of the top entry

decode_string.brute:
while s contains "[":   (one innermost group per pass)
    close_at = index of the first "]"   (it closes an innermost group)
    open_at = index of the last "[" before close_at
    start = open_at
    while start > 0 and s[start - 1] is a digit: start -= 1   (walk back over the digits of k)
    k = the number in s[start .. open_at)
    inner = s between open_at and close_at
    s = s before start + inner repeated k times + s after close_at   (rebuilds the whole string)
return s

basic_calculator_ii.optimal:
stack = empty, num = 0, op = "+"   (op = the operator BEFORE the number being read)
for each i, ch in s:
    if ch is a digit: num = num * 10 + ch
    if ch is an operator or ch is the last character:   (number finished: apply the pending op)
        if op == "+": push num
        else if op == "-": push -num
        else if op == "*": push (pop the top) * num
        else: push (pop the top) / num truncated toward zero
        num = 0, op = ch
return the sum of the stack

daily_temperatures.optimal:
answer = array of n zeros
waiting = empty stack of indices of days still waiting for a warmer day
for each day i:
    while waiting is not empty and temperature at the top < temperatures[i]:
        j = pop the top   (today is day j's first warmer day)
        answer[j] = i - j
    push i
return answer

car_fleet.optimal:
cars = list of [position, speed] pairs
sort cars by position, closest to the target first
fleets = empty stack of arrival times of fleet leaders
for each car:
    time = (target - car's position) / car's speed
    if fleets is empty or time > top of fleets:
        push time   (slower than the fleet ahead: a new fleet)
    else: it catches the fleet ahead and merges into it, adding nothing
return size of fleets

implement_queue_using_stacks.brute:
init: main = empty stack   (the oldest element sits on top)
push(x):
    helper = empty stack
    while main is not empty: push pop of main onto helper   (pour everything out)
    push x onto main   (x lands at the bottom)
    while helper is not empty: push pop of helper onto main   (pour it all back)
pop(): return pop the top of main
peek(): return the top of main
empty(): return main is empty
implement_queue_using_stacks.optimal:
init: inbox = empty stack (newest on top), outbox = empty stack (oldest on top)
push(x): push x onto inbox
pop():
    peek()   (make sure the outbox holds the front)
    return pop the top of outbox
peek():
    if outbox is empty:   (pour only when the outbox runs dry)
        while inbox is not empty: push pop of inbox onto outbox   (reverses the order once)
    return the top of outbox
empty(): return inbox is empty and outbox is empty

design_circular_queue.brute:
init(k): capacity = k, items = empty list
en_queue(value):
    if size of items == capacity: return false
    append value, return true
de_queue():
    if items is empty: return false
    remove items[0]   (shifts every element one slot left)
    return true
front(): return -1 if items is empty else items[0]
rear(): return -1 if items is empty else the last item
is_empty(): return items is empty
is_full(): return size of items == capacity
design_circular_queue.optimal:
init(k): buf = array of k slots, head = 0, count = 0
en_queue(value):
    if full: return false
    tail = (head + count) mod k   (wraps from slot k-1 back to slot 0)
    buf[tail] = value
    count += 1, return true
de_queue():
    if empty: return false
    head = (head + 1) mod k   (move the index, not the data)
    count -= 1, return true
front(): return -1 if empty else buf[head]
rear(): return -1 if empty else buf[(head + count - 1) mod k]
is_empty(): return count == 0
is_full(): return count == k

dota2_senate.optimal:
n = length of senate
radiant = empty deque, dire = empty deque
for each i: append i to radiant if senate[i] == "R" else to dire
while both deques are not empty:
    r = pop the front of radiant, d = pop the front of dire   (the two who act soonest face off)
    if r < d: append r + n to radiant   (r acts first: bans d, votes again next round)
    else: append d + n to dire
return "Radiant" if radiant is not empty else "Dire"
